faqs.q: What is Aave and how does the APY work?
faqs.a: Aave is a DeFi protocol where you deposit crypto to earn interest (supply APY) or borrow against collateral (borrow APY). Rates are set by pool utilization on each chain.

faqs.q: Which chain has the best Aave APY today?
faqs.a: It changes minute to minute. Stablecoins (USDC, USDT) on L2s like Base, Arbitrum and Polygon usually offer the most competitive effective APYs once Merit/Merkl incentives are included.

faqs.q: Do I need to connect a wallet?
faqs.a: No. aaveapy.com is 100% read-only. You only connect a wallet on the official Aave app when you decide to act.
